_comment: World dressing, coordinator Meshy batch 31 Oct (tb/props-r2 31592e46, assets/props/meshy-1031, provenance.json in each folder). OFF until GPU judged. Visible meshes only (scripts/world/meshy_camp_props.gd): old meshes hidden, not freed, so colliders, rest body, build index and craft offers are unchanged.
